design_status: Retrospective source-informed design, fixed before new benchmark fits; not preregistered or blinded.
parameter_source: Explicit exploratory search bounds, not measured strain constants. No source-fitted parameter is fixed or used as a start.
hypothesis: Effective saturating substrate-limited biomass growth, constant apparent yield, and first-order loss of measured biomass; cellulose hydrolysis is unresolved.
initial_conditions: Reported t=0 biomass and nominal substrate; initial values excluded from residuals.
mapping: X is measured culture biomass, not viable or induced biomass; S is the reported bulk substrate assay.
uncertainty: No replicate errors or censoring limits available; no likelihood, p-value, confidence interval, or biological acceptance threshold.
scope: T. harzianum P49P11, reported stirred batch medium, 29 C, pH 5 +/- 0.5, oxygen controlled >30%, 0-96 h. Separate substrate fits; no cross-strain or scale-up prediction.
design_notes: A training-only numerical pilot exhausted 300 evaluations with scipy default finite differences. Explicit 1e-4 relative differences in log parameters reduce ODE-solver derivative noise; no held-out scores were evaluated in that pilot.
